output.content: The nightly pipeline runs the same way it always has. Once the raw scan lines finish ingesting, the system does not push them into the validation queue on its own. An engineer has to manually send a request to start that next stage. The on call person handles that click every single night before the validation scripts kick in. We did not touch the trigger logic during the review, so the manual gate remains the only way to bridge those two steps in the current setup. The logs show the timestamp of that manual request sitting between the ingestion completion and the validation start.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively describes the current operational state of the pipeline, specifically that a manual trigger is required between ingestion and validation, without expressing any wishes, trade-offs, or needs.
